_: Библиотека комнат для пакета артикула. Источник правды для material_cube.py. Комнату добавляют сюда, а не в промпт руками. Тексты сцен по-английски, названия для каталога по-русски.

bath_floor.scene: A modern bathroom: freestanding white bathtub along the back wall, wall-hung white vanity with a round mirror on the right wall, a towel rail, one green plant. Walls are plain light neutral plaster.

bath_wall.scene: A modern bathroom: freestanding white bathtub in front of the back wall, wall-hung white vanity with a round mirror on the right wall, a towel rail. The floor is plain light-grey microcement.

shower_wall.scene: A walk-in shower zone filling the back of the room: frameless clear glass partition on the left, brushed-steel rain shower head, a niche with two white bottles. The floor is plain light-grey microcement.

wc_wall.scene: A compact guest toilet: wall-hung white toilet centred against the back wall, small white basin on the right wall, a slim mirror. The floor is plain light-grey microcement.

kitchen_backsplash.scene: A modern kitchen seen straight on: a straight run of matte white handleless kitchen units along the back wall, light wood worktop, built-in hob and a sink with a black tap, open shelf with a few ceramic bowls. Upper wall above the backsplash is plain white plaster. The floor is plain light oak.

kitchen_floor.scene: A modern kitchen seen straight on: a straight run of matte light-grey handleless kitchen units along the back wall, light worktop, a small round dining table with two chairs in the foreground on the left. Walls are plain white plaster.

hallway_floor.scene: An apartment entrance hall: a white entrance door in the centre of the back wall, a slim bench with a pair of shoes on the left, a coat rack and a full-height mirror on the right wall. Walls are plain warm-white plaster.

living_floor.scene: A bright living room: a light-grey sofa against the back wall, a low light-wood coffee table, a soft round rug that covers only a small part of the floor, a floor lamp and a large plant. Walls are plain warm-white plaster.

living_accent_wall.scene: A bright living room: a low TV console and a slim wall-mounted TV on the back wall, a light-grey sofa seen from behind in the foreground. Side walls are plain warm-white plaster, the floor is light oak.

bedroom_floor.scene: A calm bedroom: a double bed with white linen against the back wall, two bedside tables with small lamps, a bench at the foot of the bed. Walls are plain soft-beige plaster.

kids_floor.scene: A light children's room: a single bed with a pastel blanket against the back wall, a low open toy shelf, a small play tent in the corner, a few wooden toys on the floor. Walls are plain pale-sage plaster.

balcony_floor.scene: A glazed loggia: a wide window across the back wall with a city view in soft daylight, two wicker chairs and a small round table, a few potted plants. Side walls are plain white plaster.

layouts.straight: laid in a straight grid, joints aligned
layouts.offset_half: laid in a running bond, each row offset by half a piece
layouts.offset_third: laid in a running bond, each row offset by one third of a piece
layouts.planks_random: planks laid in a staggered pattern with random end joints, running away from the camera into the depth of the room
